name: No one Asked her with Firerose

episodes.title: What They Don't Tell You About Narcissists With Mark Vicente | No One Asked Her With Firerose
episodes.description:
Firerose's amazing guest on this episode of No One Asked Her is award-winning filmmaker, author, and cult survivor Mark Vicente. His work includes the groundbreaking film What the Bleep Do We Know!?, acclaimed HBO documentary series The Vow, which chronicles his courageous journey out of the NXIVM cult, and his bone-chillingly brilliant latest film, Narcissist’s Playbook.

In this incredible conversation, Firerose and Mark dive deep into unveiling psychopathy and narcissistic personality disorder, exposing how these abusers manipulate, deceive, and control.

Together, they unpack the psychological tactics and hidden patterns of abuse, revealing how the dark triad, coercive control, cult dynamics, and trauma intersect. They trace the unmistakable patterns of abuse used by all narcissists to gain supply and the lasting impact it has on survivors.
